description: This file defines the JournalEntrySummary entity, which represents a summarized record of journal entries aggregated for a specific date, product, account, and office within the Fineract project. It maps to the database table 'm_journal_entry_aggregation_summary' and extends an auditable base class for tracking change history.

classes.name: JournalEntrySummary
classes.description: Entity class representing a summary of journal entries for reporting and aggregation purposes in the system.
